paraphrase: As a boy Basava refuses the sacred-thread initiation of his brāhmaṇa family, taking devotion to Śiva as his only sacrament, and leaves for Kūḍalasaṅgama.
speaker: Harihara (narrator)
notes: Skeleton from memory; locator is the incipit (or a descriptive key when the incipit is not recalled) because vacana numbering differs between editions — fix against the Samagra Vacana Sāhitya in Phase D. Told in the hagiographies from Harihara onward; episode placement unverified.
